why: PRESCRIPTION 8d44aef626d9, applied whole. At standard-v3 the working list won 4 of 47 while the fleet sits at 0.28-0.41; the 59 logs say sythis-enchantress kills zur by combat (Sigil angels 293 dmg, aura'd Sythis 243, indestructible Heliod 236, Hallowed Haunting spirits 140) behind Privileged Position in 21 of 59 games, which blanks seven targeted answers. Ten swaps: two untargeted answers (Winds of Abandon overloaded, Aetherize), the two cast-trigger clocks that killed zur from the other seat (Sigil, Hallowed Haunting), drain that ignores a fort (Sanguine Bond, Blind Obedience, Suture Priest, Authority of the Consuls), a three-mana fort (Ghostly Prison) and cast-draw (Mesa Enchantress); out go the five Shrines and Spirit Oasis (X=1 by drain-v1's arithmetic), Muddle, Cathars' Crusade, Ajani's Chosen, Hypnotic Siren, Gremlin Tamer. The goldfish objective is a proxy: five of the ten adds are invisible to it by construction, and the verdict is Forge at standard-v3 against the working list's 0.085.
